item.title: The Tonics: suburban a cappella singers are improbable social media stars
item.description: After three decades, an aging male acapella group is building a following by posting video of their rehearsals around suburban, island kitchens. How the Tonics turned social media shade into success.

item.title: How Brazil's two leading presidential candidates are talking about crime
item.description: Crime is at the top of voters' concerns in Brazil ahead of Sunday's national elections. Many are calling for tougher measures — part of a broader rightward shift across Latin America.

item.title: Following far-right and far-left gains, Germany's center struggles for relevance
item.description: After gains for the far-right and far-left, Germany's centrist politicians are soul-searching among echoes of a past that led to the collapse of the Weimar Republic and rise of fascism decades ago.

item.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
item.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

item.title: Remembering Brooke Eby, the TikTok star who documented her ALS journey
item.description: After Brooke Eby was diagnosed with ALS, she started to document her experience. The influencer was perhaps best known for her humor. Now, four years after her official diagnosis, Eby has died.
